blocks: A conventional pool changes a garden.
For most of us a swimming pool means a tiled box. It is one answer, not the only one.
Water that is treated A conventional pool is usually kept clean with a chemical sanitiser.
A hard edge Tiles and paving take the place of planting.
Equipment to run Pumps and filters, and often heating, through the season.
Questions asked late Space, ground, planning and safety are easier to answer before anything is designed.
Water that is cleaned by the garden itself.
Biological filtration, a planted regeneration area and gentle circulation.
Biological filtration : plants and microorganisms in planted gravel
Water circulation : between the two areas, in many designs helped by a pump
